title: Agent Role-Play Practice Script & Tanglish Training Dataset

agent_phrases.greeting: Hi, thanks for calling. My name is [Agent]. How can I help you today?
agent_phrases.asking: Could I get your full name, please?
agent_phrases.confirming: Just to make sure I have it right, that's [Details], correct?
agent_phrases.clarifying: Sorry, could you repeat that? / Could you spell that for me?
agent_phrases.pausing: Give me just a moment while I note that down.
agent_phrases.closing: Is there anything else I can help you with? Have a great day!

scenarios_english.title: Scenario 1: General Customer Details

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Hello, thank you for calling. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Hi Sam. I'd like to open an account with your company.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Of course, I'd be happy to help with that. Before we start, may I have your full name, please?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Sure. It's Daniel Roberts.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you, Daniel. Could you spell your last name for me?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: R-O-B-E-R-T-S.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Perfect. And what's the best phone number to reach you on?

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Great, 555-0142. Do you also have an email address I can use?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, it's daniel.roberts at example dot com.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Let me read that back: daniel dot roberts at example dot com. Is that right?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Wonderful. And which city do you live in?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: I live in Chicago.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thanks, Daniel. I have everything I need. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: No, that's all. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: You're very welcome. Have a great day!

scenarios_english.practice_tip: Always repeat phone numbers and emails back to the customer.

scenarios_english.title: Scenario 2: Booking an Appointment

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Good morning! Thanks for calling Brightside Clinic. This is Sam speaking. How may I help you?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment, please.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Sure, no problem. May I have your name?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Maria Lopez.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you, Maria. What day would you like to come in?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Maybe next Tuesday, if possible.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Let me check. Would morning or afternoon work better for you?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Morning is better. Around 10 o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: I have 10:30 available. Would that be okay?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, 10:30 is fine.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Great. And may I ask what the visit is for?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: It's just a regular check-up.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Got it. Could I have a phone number in case we need to reschedule?

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you. So that's Maria Lopez, next Tuesday at 10:30 AM for a check-up. Is that correct?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, perfect.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: All set! We'll see you then. Take care, Maria!

scenarios_english.practice_tip: Confirm the date, time, and name at the end to avoid mistakes.

scenarios_english.title: Scenario 3: Handling a Complaint (Order Problem)

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Hello, thanks for contacting support. I'm Sam. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Hi, my order hasn't arrived yet and it's been two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: I'm so sorry to hear that. I'll do my best to sort it out. Could I have your name, please?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: It's James Carter.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you, James. Do you have your order number handy?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, it's 48291.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thanks. Give me a moment while I look that up... I can see the order was shipped but seems delayed. When did you place it?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: On the 1st of this month.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Okay, thank you. Would you prefer that we send a replacement, or would you like a refund?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: A replacement would be great.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Understood. Could you confirm your delivery address so I can make sure it's correct?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: 12 Oak Street, Springfield.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you. I've arranged a replacement and you'll receive an email confirmation shortly. Again, I'm sorry for the trouble.

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Thanks for your help, Sam.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: My pleasure, James. Is there anything else I can do for you?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: No, that's everything.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Have a lovely day!

scenarios_english.practice_tip: Show empathy first, then ask for details. A calm, kind voice helps a lot.

scenarios_english.title: Scenario 4: Job Application Screening

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Hi, this is Sam from the HR team. Is this a good time to talk for a few minutes?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Yes, I have time now.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Great. Thanks for applying. Could you tell me your full name?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Priya Sharma.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Nice to meet you, Priya. What are you doing currently, work-wise?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: I'm working as a customer service executive at a telecom company.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Interesting. How many years of experience do you have?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: About three years.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Wonderful. If selected, when would you be able to start?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: I need to give one month's notice.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: That's fine. And what salary range are you expecting?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: Somewhere around 40,000 per month.

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: Thank you for sharing that. I've noted everything down. Do you have any questions for me?

dialogue.speaker: CUSTOMER
dialogue.line: When will I hear back?

dialogue.speaker: AGENT
dialogue.line: You'll hear from us within a week. Thanks for your time, Priya, and good luck!

scenarios_english.practice_tip: Ask one question at a time and let the person finish speaking.

email.subject: Confirmation of Your Details
email.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for speaking with me today. I'm writing to confirm the details you gave me:

• Name: [Name]
• Phone: [Phone]
• Email: [Email]
• City: [City]

If anything looks incorrect, please reply to this email and I'll fix it right away.

Kind regards,
[Agent Name]
Customer Support Team

whatsapp_tanglish.body:
Hi [Name] sir/madam, vanakkam. [Agent Name] here from Customer Support.

Call la neenga sonna details confirm panren:
• Name: [Name]
• Phone: [Phone]
• Email: [Email]
• City: [City]

Edhavadhu thappu irundha, please reply pannunga. Naan udane correct panren.

Thanks,
[Agent Name]

self_check_checklist: I greeted the customer politely and introduced myself / Vanakkam sollitu introduce pannitten.
I asked one question at a time / Oru time la oru question dhaan kettein.
I repeated important details (phone, email, dates) back / Phone, email, date ellam repeat panni confirm pannitten.
I thanked the customer and asked if they needed anything else / Last la 'Vera edhavadhu help venuma?' nu kettein.
I closed the conversation warmly / Nandri sollitu polite ah call mudichen.
